fullContent:
Dinesavalyadi Keram 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam, Taila Yoga Prakarana 
 Introduction 
 Dinesavalyadi Keram is an Ayurvedic medicine in herbal oil form. It is used for the treatment of wounds. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Kalka dravya – Bolus prepared from Dinesavalli bark – Ventilago maderaspatana – 96 g 
 Coconut oil – 384 ml 
 Juice extract of Dinesavalli and Punarnava (Boerhaavia diffusa) – 768 ml each. 
 
 Method of Prepraration 
 All the ingredients are added to coconut oil and oil is prepared by oil paak method. 
 How to Use? 
 It is used for external application over the affected part. 
 Indications 
 It is used for quick wound healing. 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no known side effects of this medicine, on external application. 
 This product is not meant for oral administration. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
